This issue is caused by the latest client update of VRChat and not related to Meta Quest firmware.
****************************************************
More importantly, this problem occurs not only in Quest2, but also in Quest1.
*****************************************************
I checked it with [build-1156] on 2021-12-08-14:00 (PST), and at that time the photos were still saved and could be picked up from the device.
However, a minute later, as soon as I updated to [build-1159], the photo saving feature stopped working.
In both situations, Quest was v35 firmware.
Therefore, build-1159 of VRChat contains a bug, metaphorically, which turned Quest users' VR cameras into cam recorders that forgot to insert the SD-memory-card.
I would very much appreciate it if you could find out the cause and resolve the issue.
